integrity_notes: The result is a new mathematical analysis of a published statistic. It does not claim authorship of the originating statistic, an independent audit, a current journal publication, or a universal significance correction.
limitations: The theorem applies to iid Poisson triangular arrays with means increasing logarithmically and weights approaching the exponential-family boundary, not to fixed mean/weight experiments.
The 36.79% figure applies to the specified two-sided Gaussian calibration and an explicit sequence, not to bootstrap or simulation-based calibration.
No universal finite-sample error rate or robust alternative calibration is proved.
The new theorem and published formulas have received only a non-independent review; broader historical priority remains open.
title: Reciprocal-Poisson breakdown of Gaussian calibration for an exponential-weight Stein–Chen ratio
